G2300.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb;

G2315.derivation: from G2316 (θεός) and a presumed derivative of G4154 (πνέω);

G2316.derivation: of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with G3588 (ὁ)) the supreme Divinity;
G2316.def: figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very

G2319.derivation: from G2316 (θεός) and the base of G4767 (στυγνητός);

G2321.def: friend of God; Theophilus, a Christian

G2325.derivation: from G2330 (θέρος) (in the sense of the crop);

G2367.derivation: from a derivative of G2380 (θύω) (in the sense of blowing;
